SOP.description: Two-sided package layout; exact pitch, mounting and pin count unresolved

QF.description: Four-sided package layout; exact outline and pin count unresolved

TO.description: Power/tab package layout represented by the TO training group

note: Grouping describes layout compatibility, not exact package recognition. DIP/SOP, QFP/QFN and individual TO variants remain distinct references. BGA/CSP, DFN and small SOT packages have no automatic group. Override keys are normalized full package names and values are SOP, QF, TO, or null to exclude.
